item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: Normal people believe that if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Engineers believe that if it ain’t broke, it doesn’t have enough features yet. Scott Adams Building on yesterday, I linked my static pi website to tonystark-webmaster.com using cloudflare secure tunnels without exposing any ports. I installed docker to make everything clean and breakable. cloudflared connector is isolated. Finally you guys can see my blog live now after day 4.

item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: Normal people believe that if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Engineers believe that if it ain’t broke, it doesn’t have enough features yet. Scott Adams I picked up my raspberry pi from the drawer, Connected it to power and ethernet, Flashed it with dietpi. Now I’ve a 24/7 soldier guarding my network with Pi-hole. and everything is degoogled and private using ubound recursive dns. I’ll be adding more services in the future stay tuned.

item.title: Sharing and Commiting
item.description: It is not the mountain we conquer, but ourselves. Sir Edmund Hillary The morning was energized. Outside work and meetings are done. I guess it’s time to get shit done. following networkchuck blogging video 2024 I learned the following things Connecting github to local git via ssh-key Basic Hugo websites and themes Basic gitsubmodules git init git config –global user.name “Dr-Mordor” git config –global user.email “test@tonystark-webmaster.com” rsync -av –delete source destination ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C “test@tonystark-webmaster.

item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: I’ve had my ups and downs, my fair share of bumpy roads and heavy winds. thats what made me what I am today.Van damme In a warm summer evening I got fed up by my procrastination and lack of progress in life. This was a month ago when the wake up call hit me. I needed to wake up and focus on my what am I doing in my life, building my career.
